_README: Importable n8n workflow that watches Gmail and forwards new messages to Denizen's /api/email-inbound. After import: (1) attach your Gmail OAuth2 credential to the 'Gmail Trigger' node, (2) edit the HTTP Request node's URL to your Denizen host, (3) set the X-Denizen-Secret header to the same value you set in EMAIL_INBOUND_SECRET on the Denizen server. Activate the workflow.
name: Denizen — Gmail inbox to Sarah
